objective: Continuation authorized by the owner on 2026-10-29 ('Yes, let's continue'), after the owner put hub laws in scope ('Should hub laws be in scope?' 'Yes.'). GEOMETRY-LAW-20261029-001 proved that under native gluing (every distinction in at most two knots) only parity survives patterns of patterns: rebuilding a knot from native gadgets of its own copies. Hubs, distinctions shared by three or more copies, are a declared substrate: equality fan-out, never counted as contact or emergence (the canonical common hub). Questions: (1) which of the 16 classes of three-bit knots (up to coordinate order) are rebuilt by non-degenerate hub gadgets of their own copies (legs in one copy each, hidden variables in at least two copies, no variable twice in a copy, connected), at which sizes, and by what mechanism (scoping: copies in parallel intersect their constraints, which native gluing cannot do); (2) not-all-equal: scoping found it rebuilt by its copies on the lines of the Fano plane with one point split into the three legs; is that the smallest such gadget, and is it unique, so that the law's minimal pattern of patterns is a finite projective plane; (3) what the surviving laws' towers look like. Standalone value relative to the nearest known work: the Fano plane is the unique smallest 3-uniform hypergraph without property B (m(3) = 7; Erdos-Hajnal line, arXiv 2303.03803), and NAE reductions use other gadgets; Holant-clone and pp-definability results (Feder 2001; Kazda, Kolmogorov and Rolinek) ask what gadgets define, not which relations are rebuilt by gadgets of their own copies. Intuitions targeted: space from logic without a drawn space (an incidence geometry from a law); patterns of patterns and the growth of emergent information; infinite cycles that are universally influential; the two/three boundary (hubs are equality fan-out). No time constraints.
status: Complete 2026-10-29: which knots survive patterns of patterns once hubs are allowed. With hubs, copies in parallel intersect their constraints; within six copies exactly seven of the 16 three-bit classes are rebuilt (parity; and from four copies x or (y != z), the three-excluded classes with a symmetry of order two, twisted not-all-equal); the monotone atoms never are. Not-all-equal is rebuilt by its copies on the Fano plane with one point split into the legs, with no smaller gadget and uniqueness at seven copies (property B, m(3) = 7; exhaustive search of 17.6 million seven-copy gadgets), and it is an exact counted fixed point (5 completions per tuple). Next: exact self-similar laws (2/3), deferred to the owner.
stop_rule: Stop when (i) the classes rebuilt by hub gadgets of up to six copies are classified with explicit rebuilding gadgets and, for the classes never rebuilt, a proof for all sizes or a precise open case; (ii) not-all-equal's minimal rebuilding gadget is proved (size and uniqueness) or the claim is refuted; (iii) the decision note states what hubs add to patterns of patterns and to geometry from a law, with a recommendation. Record negative results.
title: Which knots survive patterns of patterns once hubs are allowed
